title: Deep-learning analysis of whole prostatectomy specimens was evaluated against pathology and recurrence outcomes
summary: A deep-learning image-analysis system assessed whole prostatectomy slides from 992 patients for grading, tumor quantification, and recurrence outcomes. Algorithm-derived measures showed associations with pathology and biochemical progression, but the retrospective single-center study does not establish prospective workflow benefit.
ai_technology: A semantic-segmentation convolutional network analyzed whole-slide prostatectomy histology images.
organization: Deep Bio Inc., Seoul, Republic of Korea

evidence.tested: Retrospective comparison in 992 patients assessed algorithm grading, tumor quantification, and biochemical progression against pathology and clinical outcomes.
evidence.unknown: Single-center retrospective results do not establish prospective workflow impact.
evidence.ai_role: A semantic-segmentation CNN analyzed whole-slide histology for grade and tumor quantification.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text review as recorded in case evidence; record-level claim and attribution review.
